description: Activity "flipped-instruction" from SF.Activities.makeSlides, stepped through stage by stage with three phones answering whatever it asks (notes, replies), Bo dropping on its first prompt, the teacher-entered learner in the room, journal.

data.title: Review the home learning
data.text:
Recall — What is perimeter? Explain without looking at your notes.
Check — A 5 × 3 rectangle: is its perimeter 15 or 16 units? Why?
Questions — Which part of the home learning needs another explanation?

data.title: Review the home learning
data.text:

Check — A 5 × 3 rectangle: is its perimeter 15 or 16 units? Why?

data.title: Find the missing length
data.text:
Deep dive — A rectangle has perimeter 34 cm and width 6 cm. Find its length.
Think aloud — Two widths use 12 cm. The two lengths share the remaining 22 cm.
Explain — Why do we divide the remaining length by two?

data.title: Find the missing length
data.text:
Deep dive — A rectangle has perimeter 34 cm and width 6 cm. Find its length.
Think aloud — Two widths use 12 cm. The two lengths share the remaining 22 cm.
Explain — Why do we divide the remaining length by two?

data.title: Apply and check
data.text:
Core — Find the length when perimeter is 42 cm and width is 8 cm.
Support — Draw and label all four sides before calculating.
Challenge — Find three rectangles with perimeter 42 cm. Which has the largest area?
